requirements.requirement: The subject is a movie star who was born in 1987 and began their acting career in 2010.
As of 2022, the subject had been nominated for eight awards and had won four awards, with wins in 2017, 2019, 2021, and 2022.
The subject's first name is the same as the first name of two of the 12 disciples in the Bible.
As of 2023, the subject had an older sibling who was also a movie star.
The subject acted in a soap opera, and the name of the first soap opera they acted in (the earliest soap opera among their soap-opera roles) is to be established.
